entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
entries.source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: You see a police officer of the Hub.
entries.source_text: You see a police officer of the Hub.

entries.text: 你看到了一位哈勃城的警官。
entries.source_text: 你看到了一位哈勃城的警官。

entries.text: I wish I was stationed closer to my home.
entries.source_text: I wish I was stationed closer to my home.

entries.text: 我希望能分配到离家近一点的地方。
entries.source_text: 我希望能分配到离家近一点的地方。

entries.text: I wonder what happened to those caravans.
entries.source_text: I wonder what happened to those caravans.

entries.text: 我奇怪这些商队都发生了什么。
entries.source_text: 我奇怪这些商队都发生了什么。

entries.text: Move along.
entries.source_text: Move along.

entries.text: 继续。
entries.source_text: 继续。

entries.text: You'd better keep your weapons holstered, stranger.
entries.source_text: You'd better keep your weapons holstered, stranger.

entries.text: 你最好收好你的武器，陌生人。
entries.source_text: 你最好收好你的武器，陌生人。

entries.text: Keep your nose clean.
entries.source_text: Keep your nose clean.

entries.text: 安分点。
entries.source_text: 安分点。

entries.text: Do you have any commodities to declare?
entries.source_text: Do you have any commodities to declare?

entries.text: 你有什么贵重品需要申报？
entries.source_text: 你有什么贵重品需要申报？

entries.text: Don't be waving your weapon in my face.
entries.source_text: Don't be waving your weapon in my face.

entries.text: 别在我的面前挥舞你的武器。
entries.source_text: 别在我的面前挥舞你的武器。

entries.text: Put that away unless you want some jail time.
entries.source_text: Put that away unless you want some jail time.

entries.text: 把那个收起来，除非你想在监狱里呆一阵子。
entries.source_text: 把那个收起来，除非你想在监狱里呆一阵子。

entries.text: Are you aiming that at me?
entries.source_text: Are you aiming that at me?

entries.text: 你在用那个指着我吗？
entries.source_text: 你在用那个指着我吗？

entries.text: I've heard of you. Watch it.
entries.source_text: I've heard of you. Watch it.

entries.text: 我听说过你。看看这个。
entries.source_text: 我听说过你。看看这个。

entries.text: We'll be keeping an eye on you.
entries.source_text: We'll be keeping an eye on you.

entries.text: 我们会注意你的。
entries.source_text: 我们会注意你的。

entries.text: No fighting in our town, tough guy.
entries.source_text: No fighting in our town, tough guy.

entries.text: 我们镇不允许殴斗，暴徒。
entries.source_text: 我们镇不允许殴斗，暴徒。

entries.text: We don't like baby killers!
entries.source_text: We don't like baby killers!

entries.text: 我们不喜欢杀小孩儿的人！
entries.source_text: 我们不喜欢杀小孩儿的人！

entries.text: Lay a hand on a kid and we'll hunt you down.
entries.source_text: Lay a hand on a kid and we'll hunt you down.

entries.text: 敢动孩子们一根手指头，我们就会追捕你。
entries.source_text: 敢动孩子们一根手指头，我们就会追捕你。

entries.text: I hate people like you.
entries.source_text: I hate people like you.

entries.text: 我讨厌像你这样的人。
entries.source_text: 我讨厌像你这样的人。

entries.text: Don't call for help if you're in trouble.
entries.source_text: Don't call for help if you're in trouble.

entries.text: 遇上麻烦的时候别指望求救。
entries.source_text: 遇上麻烦的时候别指望求救。

entries.text: Hey, thanks for doing our work for us.
entries.source_text: Hey, thanks for doing our work for us.

entries.text: 嘿，谢谢你帮我们代劳了。
entries.source_text: 嘿，谢谢你帮我们代劳了。

entries.text: We don't allow kill'n here, even if it is justified.
entries.source_text: We don't allow kill'n here, even if it is justified.

entries.text: 即使有正当的理由，我们这里也不允许杀人。
entries.source_text: 即使有正当的理由，我们这里也不允许杀人。

entries.text: If you're the one that killed the Deathclaw . . . thank you.
entries.source_text: If you're the one that killed the Deathclaw . . . thank you.

entries.text: 如果你是那个杀了死亡爪的人……那么谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 如果你是那个杀了死亡爪的人……那么谢谢你。

entries.text: Keep your nose clean while you're in our city.
entries.source_text: Keep your nose clean while you're in our city.

entries.text: 在我们城市的时候安分点。
entries.source_text: 在我们城市的时候安分点。

entries.text: I would keep clear of Decker if I was you.
entries.source_text: I would keep clear of Decker if I was you.

entries.text: 如果我是你的话，就会和德克保持距离的。
entries.source_text: 如果我是你的话，就会和德克保持距离的。

entries.text: Enjoy your stay.
entries.source_text: Enjoy your stay.

entries.text: 住的愉快。
entries.source_text: 住的愉快。

entries.text: Welcome to the Hub!
entries.source_text: Welcome to the Hub!

entries.text: 欢迎来到哈勃城！
entries.source_text: 欢迎来到哈勃城！

entries.text: Greetings, stranger.
entries.source_text: Greetings, stranger.

entries.text: 你好啊，陌生人。
entries.source_text: 你好啊，陌生人。

entries.text: Visit the Maltese Falcon for refreshing drinks.
entries.source_text: Visit the Maltese Falcon for refreshing drinks.

entries.text: 到马耳他猎鹰酒吧去喝几杯提提神吧。
entries.source_text: 到马耳他猎鹰酒吧去喝几杯提提神吧。

entries.text: Follow the main road if you're looking for the market.
entries.source_text: Follow the main road if you're looking for the market.

entries.text: 顺着主干道走，就可以找到商场了。
entries.source_text: 顺着主干道走，就可以找到商场了。

entries.text: Keep moving.
entries.source_text: Keep moving.

entries.text: 继续前进。
entries.source_text: 继续前进。

entries.text: Move along. Move along.
entries.source_text: Move along. Move along.

entries.text: 继续。继续。
entries.source_text: 继续。继续。

entries.text: We're here to Prevent and Survey.
entries.source_text: We're here to Prevent and Survey.

entries.text: 我们在这儿是为了调查和预防。
entries.source_text: 我们在这儿是为了调查和预防。

entries.text: Keep that weapon under control while you're in our city.
entries.source_text: Keep that weapon under control while you're in our city.

entries.text: 在我们城里，管好你的武器。
entries.source_text: 在我们城里，管好你的武器。

entries.text: Don't you get into any fights with that.
entries.source_text: Don't you get into any fights with that.

entries.text: 别再挑事了。
entries.source_text: 别再挑事了。

entries.text: I'd recommend putting your weapon away.
entries.source_text: I'd recommend putting your weapon away.

entries.text: 我建议你把武器收起来。
entries.source_text: 我建议你把武器收起来。

entries.text: You should put that away . . . your weapon, that is.
entries.source_text: You should put that away . . . your weapon, that is.

entries.text: 你应该把那个收起来……你的武器，就那个。
entries.source_text: 你应该把那个收起来……你的武器，就那个。

entries.text: Welcome Paladin, it's been a while.
entries.source_text: Welcome Paladin, it's been a while.

entries.text: 欢迎，骑士，
entries.source_text: 欢迎，骑士，

entries.text: You're that rowdy one. No more fighting okay?
entries.source_text: You're that rowdy one. No more fighting okay?

entries.text: 你就是那无赖吧。别在打架了，知道吗？
entries.source_text: 你就是那无赖吧。别在打架了，知道吗？

entries.text: You better not start another fight!
entries.source_text: You better not start another fight!

entries.text: 你最好别再惹事了！
entries.source_text: 你最好别再惹事了！

entries.text: It's you . . . keep that temper of yours under control.
entries.source_text: It's you . . . keep that temper of yours under control.

entries.text: 是你……控制好你的脾气。
entries.source_text: 是你……控制好你的脾气。

entries.text: The Far Go Traders got wiped out. I can't believe it.
entries.source_text: The Far Go Traders got wiped out. I can't believe it.

entries.text: 远行商队居然出事了。我简直不能相信。
entries.source_text: 远行商队居然出事了。我简直不能相信。

entries.text: The Water Merchants are gone. What a relief.
entries.source_text: The Water Merchants are gone. What a relief.

entries.text: 净水商人已经不存在了。真是帮大忙了。
entries.source_text: 净水商人已经不存在了。真是帮大忙了。

entries.text: The Crimson Caravan has been destroyed.
entries.source_text: The Crimson Caravan has been destroyed.

entries.text: 深红商队已经被毁灭了。
entries.source_text: 深红商队已经被毁灭了。

entries.text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!
entries.source_text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!

entries.text: 你听说了吗？那些暗杀者被人除去了！
entries.source_text: 你听说了吗？那些暗杀者被人除去了！

entries.text: Decker's dead!
entries.source_text: Decker's dead!

entries.text: 德克死了！
entries.source_text: 德克死了！

entries.text: The Decker problem has finally been solved.
entries.source_text: The Decker problem has finally been solved.

entries.text: 德克这问题终于被解决了。
entries.source_text: 德克这问题终于被解决了。

entries.text: Watch your back -- this isn't a safe place.
entries.source_text: Watch your back -- this isn't a safe place.

entries.text: 看看你的后面——这里可不是个安全的地方。
entries.source_text: 看看你的后面——这里可不是个安全的地方。

entries.text: Watch your scripts, guy.
entries.source_text: Watch your scripts, guy.

entries.text: 注意你的举止，朋友。
entries.source_text: 注意你的举止，朋友。

entries.text: Watch your scripts, lady.
entries.source_text: Watch your scripts, lady.

entries.text: 注意你的举止，女士。
entries.source_text: 注意你的举止，女士。

entries.text: Old Harold's good for telling tales.
entries.source_text: Old Harold's good for telling tales.

entries.text: 老哈罗德特别善于讲故事。
entries.source_text: 老哈罗德特别善于讲故事。

entries.text: You shouldn't be here, it's not safe.
entries.source_text: You shouldn't be here, it's not safe.

entries.text: 你不应该来这儿的，不安全。
entries.source_text: 你不应该来这儿的，不安全。

entries.text: Old Town's really fallen apart.
entries.source_text: Old Town's really fallen apart.

entries.text: 老镇真的是已经支离破碎了。
entries.source_text: 老镇真的是已经支离破碎了。

entries.text: This place smells.
entries.source_text: This place smells.

entries.text: 这地方真难闻。
entries.source_text: 这地方真难闻。

entries.text: We should tear this whole area down.
entries.source_text: We should tear this whole area down.

entries.text: 我们应该拆毁这里整个区域。
entries.source_text: 我们应该拆毁这里整个区域。

entries.text: I know that damn thieves circle is around here somewhere.
entries.source_text: I know that damn thieves circle is around here somewhere.

entries.text: 我知道那些见鬼的盗贼工会就在这里的某个地方。
entries.source_text: 我知道那些见鬼的盗贼工会就在这里的某个地方。

entries.text: Poor Harold -- he's had a rough life.
entries.source_text: Poor Harold -- he's had a rough life.

entries.text: 可怜的哈罗德——他这辈子过的都很难。
entries.source_text: 可怜的哈罗德——他这辈子过的都很难。

entries.text: Keep your nose clean.
entries.source_text: Keep your nose clean.

entries.text: 安分点。
entries.source_text: 安分点。

entries.text: Hey.  I know you.  No more fighting, okay?
entries.source_text: Hey.  I know you.  No more fighting, okay?

entries.text: 嘿。我知道你。别再动拳头了，明白？
entries.source_text: 嘿。我知道你。别再动拳头了，明白？

entries.text: You'd better not be thinking of starting another fight!
entries.source_text: You'd better not be thinking of starting another fight!

entries.text: 你最好别想再来搞场子了！
entries.source_text: 你最好别想再来搞场子了！

entries.text: If we catch you fighting again, you're going in!
entries.source_text: If we catch you fighting again, you're going in!

entries.text: 如果被我们抓到你再次殴斗的话，你就得进去了！
entries.source_text: 如果被我们抓到你再次殴斗的话，你就得进去了！

entries.text: Did you hear? The Far Go Traders got wiped out.
entries.source_text: Did you hear? The Far Go Traders got wiped out.

entries.text: 你听说了吗？远行商队出事了。
entries.source_text: 你听说了吗？远行商队出事了。

entries.text: The Water Merchants are history. That's a blessing.
entries.source_text: The Water Merchants are history. That's a blessing.

entries.text: 净水商人已经成为历史了。这真是件好事。
entries.source_text: 净水商人已经成为历史了。这真是件好事。

entries.text: Someone killed off the Crimson Caravan.
entries.source_text: Someone killed off the Crimson Caravan.

entries.text: 有人把深红商队都杀光了。
entries.source_text: 有人把深红商队都杀光了。

entries.text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!
entries.source_text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!

entries.text: 你听说没？暗杀者终于被消灭了！
entries.source_text: 你听说没？暗杀者终于被消灭了！

entries.text: Decker's dead!
entries.source_text: Decker's dead!

entries.text: 德克死了！
entries.source_text: 德克死了！

entries.text: This town would be safer with Decker out of the picture.
entries.source_text: This town would be safer with Decker out of the picture.

entries.text: 这个城镇没有了德克会更安全。
entries.source_text: 这个城镇没有了德克会更安全。
